[[Dragonmark Enhancement|Chimera's Vitality]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Chimera's Vitality]]:''' This item grants extra bonuses if the wearer has been bestowed with Dragonmarks. You gain +1 use of Greater Dragonmark and +5 Quality PRR per Dragonmark you have.
Dragonmark of Sentinel bonus: You gain the effects of the [[Deific Warding]] feat. This does not stack with the feat itself.
